text: Front pads are down to about 2mm. Rotors look fine though.
Front discs are scored pretty bad and they're under minimum thickness. Pat still got some life left.
Cabin filter is packed with leaves. Not urgent, it can wait till the next oil change.
Serpentine belt has cracks all over it. I'd do it soon, before it lets go.
Battery tested week, cold cranking amps are way under the rating. She might not start one of these mornings.
Coolant has brown and it smells burned. I'd recommend a flush.
Rear brakes. Pads are at three wheel and the rotors have a big lip on them, to both on the rear.
Left target tyrod has play in it, that's a safety thing, and it'll need an alignment after.
Engineer filter is dirty. Just a regular.
Driver side front tire has cords showing on the inside edge, can't let it go out like that.
Ficked up a screw in the right rear tire, it's in the tread we can flug it.
Valve cover gasket is seeping oil onto the exhaust manifold. You can smell it burning.
Front struts are leaking and the car keeps bouncing after bumps.
Break fluid tested at 4% moisture. Flush it.
Wipers are streaking cheap fits whenever they want.
Passenger headlight is out.
Hearing a hum from the front left that changes with speed. Wheel bearing as play.
AC is blowing warm. It's low on refrigerant, no visible leak.
NRCV boot on the passenger side is turning sling increase, and the axle clicks on turns.
Sunroof rays are clocked, wider's getting into the headliner.
Everything else looks good. Tires are fine. Brakes are fine.
Check engine light is on, code P0420, needs a diagnosis.
Sway bar and links are clunking over bumps, both sides.
Plugs are at 110,000 miles. They are overdue.
Thermostat is stuck open, the temp gauge never comes up.
Water pump is weeping at the weep hole, there's coolant crust all over it.
passenger side engine mount is tone. The engine rocks when I shift in the drive.
Rotate the tires, the fronts are wearing faster.
Transfluid is dark. 60,000 miles and it's never been changed.
Front pads and rotors both. It's metal and metal grinding.
Left brake light has burned out.
Well Pessner is chattering at the pulley wobbles.
